parameters.name: input_dir
parameters.description: Directory containing the paired plane input data.
parameters.help_text: Directory containing the paired plane input data.

parameters.name: output_dir
parameters.description: Directory where output files will be saved.
parameters.help_text: Directory where output files will be saved.

parameters.name: tmp_dir
parameters.description: Directory for the large intermediate paired-registered movies, which are deleted once decrosstalk finishes.
parameters.help_text: Directory for the large intermediate paired-registered movies, which are deleted once decrosstalk finishes.

parameters.name: debug
parameters.description: Truncate each movie to debug_duration_s seconds before processing, for a fast end-to-end smoke test.
parameters.help_text: Truncate each movie to debug_duration_s seconds before processing, for a fast end-to-end smoke test.

parameters.name: debug_duration_s
parameters.description: Movie duration [s] retained when debug is enabled. Converted to a frame count using the acquisition frame rate.
parameters.help_text: Movie duration [s] retained when debug is enabled. Converted to a frame count using the acquisition frame rate.

parameters.name: frame_rate
parameters.description: Frame rate [Hz] fallback used only when it cannot be read from acquisition/session/platform metadata. Only needed for debug truncation.
parameters.help_text: Frame rate [Hz] fallback used only when it cannot be read from acquisition/session/platform metadata. Only needed for debug truncation.

parameters.name: num_frames
parameters.description: Number of frames averaged per epoch for the episodic mean FOV. Overridden by debug_num_frames when debug is enabled.
parameters.help_text: Number of frames averaged per epoch for the episodic mean FOV. Overridden by debug_num_frames when debug is enabled.

parameters.name: debug_num_frames
parameters.description: Frames averaged per epoch for the episodic mean FOV when debug is enabled.
parameters.help_text: Frames averaged per epoch for the episodic mean FOV when debug is enabled.

parameters.name: max_num_epochs
parameters.description: Maximum number of epochs in the episodic mean FOV.
parameters.help_text: Maximum number of epochs in the episodic mean FOV.

parameters.name: nonrigid
parameters.description: Override for whether motion correction was non-rigid. Leave unset to read it from the upstream motion-correction metadata.
parameters.help_text: Override for whether motion correction was non-rigid. Leave unset to read it from the upstream motion-correction metadata.

parameters.name: block_size
parameters.description: Override for the suite2p non-rigid block size, e.g. '[128, 128]'. Leave unset to read it from the upstream motion-correction metadata.
parameters.help_text: Override for the suite2p non-rigid block size, e.g. '[128, 128]'. Leave unset to read it from the upstream motion-correction metadata.

parameters.name: chunk_size
parameters.description: Number of frames unmixed per chunk when writing the decrosstalk movie. Bounds peak memory use.
parameters.help_text: Number of frames unmixed per chunk when writing the decrosstalk movie. Bounds peak memory use.

parameters.name: pixel_size
parameters.description: Imaging plane pixel size [um].
parameters.help_text: Imaging plane pixel size [um].

parameters.name: grid_interval
parameters.description: Step of the alpha/beta grid search.
parameters.help_text: Step of the alpha/beta grid search.

parameters.name: max_grid_val
parameters.description: Maximum alpha/beta value searched.
parameters.help_text: Maximum alpha/beta value searched.

parameters.name: motion_buffer
parameters.description: Pixels cropped from each edge beyond the motion-correction crop range, to exclude non-rigid edge artifacts.
parameters.help_text: Pixels cropped from each edge beyond the motion-correction crop range, to exclude non-rigid edge artifacts.

parameters.name: dendrite_diameter_um
parameters.description: Diameter [um] below which a detected mask is treated as dendrite and discarded.
parameters.help_text: Diameter [um] below which a detected mask is treated as dendrite and discarded.

parameters.name: num_top_rois
parameters.description: Number of highest-intensity ROIs per plane retained for the mutual-information grid search.
parameters.help_text: Number of highest-intensity ROIs per plane retained for the mutual-information grid search.

parameters.name: overlap_threshold
parameters.description: Intersection-over-union above which a signal/paired mask pair is treated as the same cell duplicated by crosstalk.
parameters.help_text: Intersection-over-union above which a signal/paired mask pair is treated as the same cell duplicated by crosstalk.

parameters.name: cellpose_model_type
parameters.description: Cellpose pretrained model used to segment the mean images. The model must be present locally (CELLPOSE_LOCAL_MODELS_PATH); network downloads are disabled.
parameters.help_text: Cellpose pretrained model used to segment the mean images. The model must be present locally (CELLPOSE_LOCAL_MODELS_PATH); network downloads are disabled.

parameters.name: verify
parameters.description: Round-trip the emitted processing.json / quality_control.json through the core v2 schema objects after writing, so bad output fails in-capsule rather than downstream.
parameters.help_text: Round-trip the emitted processing.json / quality_control.json through the core v2 schema objects after writing, so bad output fails in-capsule rather than downstream.
